data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 fails the problem's requirement to identify evidence that distinguishes truly independent failures from failures merely appearing uncorrelated. Its mechanism asserts 'Infrastructure Convergence' (shared TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, cloud) negates architectural independence, but it provides no causal evidence protocol to determine whether an observed uncorrelated pattern is actually driven by these shared primitives. The problem demands a distinguishing evidentiary standard; SRC_001 instead assumes correlation by assertion without specifying the test or observation that would reveal the hidden shared cause.
